intent: Single show/hide panel with a title and a toggle.
useWhen: One disclosure whose body composes kit pieces
Order, product, or extra spec the user can hide
doNotUseWhen: Two or more related sections, one open at a time — use Accordion
A page section that folds — use Section with collapsible

trigger.note: Title on the left. Toggle is a ChevronsUpDown button, not the whole row

children.note: Revealed body. Compose kit pieces, never a local cousin

requirements: Toggle is a button with aria-expanded and aria-label Toggle {trigger}
Panel is role=region, aria-labelledby the title
Closed panel is hidden from AT

doNot: Do not invent CollapsibleTrigger or CollapsibleContent cousins
Do not use Accordion for a single block
Do not make the whole header row the button
